description: The newest published GMM news articles, optionally from one desk (section slug). Partner content is excluded. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

name: list_recent_articles

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

total.description: All matching stories, not just this page.

title: List recent news articles
